_comment: Pokéathlon stadium: Maximo the MC, fans.
0:
Young Pokéathlete!
Hello!...Runnin' outta energy?
Hello, again!Good!
My name Maximo!I'm the Pokéathlon MC!
Nice to meet you!I got you whenever you
need to know anything about the Pokéathlon.
1: Maximo: Wassup!\rI got you whenever you\nneed to know anything about\fthe Pokéathlon.\r
5:
Lemme explain the Pokéathlon!It's the connection between homies
and Pokéathletes.It's FRIENDSHIP itself!
...What?You don't get it?
OK. I'll say more this time.You build a team of three
homies to compete in ten different events!The bond between homies and
Pokéathletes get tested!That's what we call friendship!
You feel me?
6:
Lemme explain “Hurdle Dash.”
It's a event that test your speed.Your homie gotta jump
when the Hurdle get close.If it jump at the right time,
it clear the Hurdle!The total time of the three homies
give you the event score.This a event for speedy homies
that move quick like me!You feel me?Aight, any more questions?
7:
Lemme explain “Pennant Capture.” Your homies grab Pennants on
the beach.Grabbin' Pennants don't add to
your score.You gotta come back with
the Pennants.This a event for speedy and skilled
homies that move like I do!You feel me?Aight, any more questions?
8:
Lemme explain “Circle Push.”
Your homies push others to try and stay in a Circle.You get points as long as your
homies stay in a Circle.The total time of the three homies
give your score.This a event for strong homies
with stamina that's strong like me!You feel me?Aight, any more questions?
9:
Lemme explain “Block Smash.”
You smash Blocks, like it say.How many Blocks you smash
is the score you get.It's SO simple, ain't it?This a event for strong homies
that's strong like me!You feel me?Aight, any more questions?
10:
Lemme explain “Disc Catch.”
Your homies jump and catch Discs flyin' at 'em.The longer you wait before they catch
the Discs, the more points you get. The total points decide the score.This a event for strong and jumpy
homies that move like me!You feel me?
Aight, any other questions?
11:
Lemme explain “Lamp Jump.”
Your homies bounce to jump high and touch as many Lamps as they can.The more Lamps they touch, the more
points you get.The total points decide the score.This a event for jumpy homies
that's jumpy like me!You feel me?Aight, any more questions?
12:
Lemme explain “Relay Run.”
Your homies take turns runnin' as far as they can in 90 seconds.The distance of the Relay decide
the score.This a event for speedy homies
with stamina... Just like me!You feel me?Aight, any more questions?
13:
Lemme explain “Ring Drop.”
Your homies try to knock other homies outta the Ring.A tackle get you one point.
Stompin' on another homie get you two points.If your homies knock another homie
off the Ring, you get ten points.This a event for homies with
stamina just like I got!You feel me?
Aight, any more questions?
14:
Lemme explain “Snow Throw.”
Snow Throw might not ring a bell... how 'bout a Snowball fight?The more your homies hit other
homies with Snow, the higher the score.This a event for strong and
skilled homies... Just like me!You feel me?Aight, any more questions?
15:
Lemme explain “Goal Roll.”
Your homies try to roll the ball into the Goals of the other teams.Most balls get you one point.Gold balls get you
two points.The points decide your rank,
and that decide the score.This a event for strong and
skilled homies... Just like me!You feel me?Aight, any more questions?
16: Young Pokéathlete!\rDon't forget your Pokéathlon\nstretches before you work out!
17:
Me? You interested in me?
Hahaha! Oh, don't be shy.Some people call me “big bro”!But really, the big bro is...
... ... my twin brother!The “big bro,” like they say, is
really the lil bro.So this “big bro” got a
bigger bro...You feel me?
